title: LiveDeactivationRequest
description: Phase F (operator-account-onboarding): input to LiveActivationWorkflow.deactivateLive. A server-side one-click live-DEACTIVATION request, machine-attributed to the authenticated operator. The workflow emits a LivePromotionDeactivated row (invalidating the prior approval so the order-time gate fails closed) AND trips the per-(tenant, strategy) kill switch. Carries ZERO key material.

tenant_id.description: The tenant whose (tenant, strategy) live promotion is being deactivated.

broker_target.description: The live broker_target being deactivated. Recorded in the LivePromotionDeactivated subject (the gate matches subject->>'broker_target' newest-after-approval).

operator_id.description: The authenticated operator (X-Operator-Id) performing the deactivation. Recorded in the emitted LivePromotionDeactivated subject (operator_id).
